Mouse trial with a unit error

Source: R/data-mouse-trial-unit-error.R
mouse_trial_unit_error.Rd

A variant of mouse_trial with one final weight recorded in milligrams instead of grams.

Usage

mouse_trial_unit_error

Format

A data frame with 48 rows and the same 7 variables as mouse_trial.

Source

Derived from mouse_trial.

Examples

data(mouse_trial_unit_error)
mouse_trial_unit_error
